messages:
maria: heads-up: my docs PR (refs #4621) preview failed the docs CI. linkcheck + mdlint + vale reported issues. tagging @kevin @ash for quick triage.
ci-bot: preview failed: md041 (first-line-heading), MD022 (multiple-heading-underline), LINKCHECK: 2 broken links, VALE: Cliches/Hedges detected. full report: https://ci.internal/preview/4621/logs
kevin: I can take the md linting. usually MD041 is from missing top-level H1 or leading emojis. will run the pre-commit locally and push quick fix.
ash: I can follow up on linkcheck, could be relative path drift after the snippet move. do we have the failing URLs?
maria: broken links: one to /docs/sdk/python#auth and one external to https://old.example.com/setup which should be updated to https://docs.example.com/setup. both in docs/guides/setup.md
kevin: quick plan: add H1 to the top of the doc, normalize underline headings, run mdformat, then push. maria, if you want I can also add a short note in the PR explaining the external link swap.
maria: yes please. also vale flagged passive voice and cliches in the 'getting started' section. that one is intentional marketing phrasing, can we suppress the rule locally?
kevin: let's avoid suppressing unless necessary. rewording two sentences should be faster. I'll push shortly.
ci-bot: started preview build for kevin/docs-lint-fix-4621
ci-bot: preview build complete 914 lint stage: linkcheck failed (1 broken external), md passed, vale still flagged Hedges in guides/setup.md: consider revising 'we believe' phrasing.
ash: fixed the external link and updated the anchor to python-auth. pushed fix.
ci-bot: preview build complete 914 all checks passed. preview URL: https://preview.docs.internal/branches/kevin/docs-lint-fix-4621
doc-bot: PR ready for review, requesting approvals per docs handbook. maria: can you sanity check the wording change in the getting started section?
maria: checked - wording is clearer and preserves meaning. thanks for fast turnaround. approving now.
kevin: scheduling to merge in the 5pm docs merge window unless someone objects.
ash: no objections.
maria: merge away. thanks folks :rocket:
ci-bot: merged kevin/docs-lint-fix-4621 into main via scheduled merge window. live in docs site.
__notes: short, pragmatic Slack thread about docs CI failures and quick fixes for linkcheck, md lint, and vale. includes who fixed what and merge timing.
